title: smtp: RFC 5321 session state machine
description: Implement crates/smtp/src/session.rs. SMTP session over a tokio split TCP stream. State machine: enum SessionState { Fresh, Greeted, Mail { from: String }, Rcpt { from: String, to: Vec<String> }, Data { from: String, to: Vec<String> } }. On connection: send '220 <hostname> ESMTP usenet-ipfs-smtp'. Commands (case-insensitive, CRLF terminated): EHLO <domain> → 250 capabilities (250-SIZE <max>, 250-8BITMIME, 250-SMTPUTF8, 250-PIPELINING, 250 STARTTLS if TLS configured); HELO → 250; MAIL FROM:<addr> → parse addr, validate not empty, store; RCPT TO:<addr> → parse addr, add to list, reject with 550 5.1.1 if to-list would exceed max_recipients; DATA → 354, read dot-terminated body (unescape leading dots per RFC 5321 §4.5.2), call queue.enqueue(IncomingMessage{...}), reply 250; RSET → 250, reset to Greeted state; NOOP → 250; QUIT → 221 Bye, close; unknown command → 500. Read lines with tokio BufReader::read_line. Max line length 4096 bytes → 500 if exceeded. On DATA: accumulate body until CRLF.CRLF — do NOT load entire message into memory if >max_message_bytes, reject with 552.
